Start a subscription first.'; checkout returns checkout.stripe.com URL for both plans with trial_days:0). ONE BUG FOUND (web): Settings.jsx openPortal fallback dead-ends because it calls startCheckout() which tries /billing/start-trial FIRST — that endpoint returns 500 (not a trial_used error) for cancelled.vo, so the fallback hits its !trialUsed branch, shows toast.error('Could not start trial'), and never redirects to Stripe. Portal Manage-payment-method therefore still dead-ends contrary to spec.

minor.issue: Returns 500 (Internal Server Error) with body 'Internal Server Error' when the caller is a view_only user whose trial was previously consumed. Ideal contract is 400 with detail.error='trial_used' so the client fallback in Settings.startCheckout can branch to paid checkout. Right now it triggers the wrong branch and breaks the Settings openPortal→checkout fallback.

integration_issues.flow: Settings /settings/billing → 'Manage payment method' (openPortal) → fallback to Stripe Checkout when No Stripe Customer
integration_issues.issue: openPortal correctly catches the 400 'No Stripe customer on record' and enters its fallback, but the fallback calls startCheckout() which tries POST /billing/start-trial first. For cancelled.vo that endpoint returns 500 → startCheckout treats it as a non-trial_used error → toast.error 'Could not start trial' → NO redirect to checkout.stripe.com. The user still dead-ends. Verified via UI (screenshot: stayed on /settings/billing, error 500 in network) AND direct curl (POST /api/billing/start-trial for cancelled.vo → HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error'). FIX: In Settings.jsx:466, replace `await startCheckout(currentPlan)` with `await startReactivateCheckout(currentPlan)` (already exists at /app/frontend/src/lib/reactivate.js — POSTs /payments/checkout with trial_days:0 directly). This is exactly what ReadOnlyLock and ToolLockGate already use.

Web openPortal attempts to redirect to Stripe checkout via startCheckout(), but that path is broken by the /billing/start-trial 500 (see integration issue). Result: parity claim not met — mobile: user reaches a functional Reactivate surface; web: user is stuck on /settings/billing with an error toast.

rca of the issue:
RCA — Settings openPortal 'No Stripe customer' fallback dead-end (web only)

Steps to reproduce:
1. Login as cancelled.vo@example.com / AccessTest1! (access_state=view_only, no Stripe customer)
2. Navigate to /settings/billing
3. Click 'Manage payment method' button (bottom-right of Payment method card)

Observed:
- Network: POST /api/payments/portal → 400 {"detail":"No Stripe customer on record. Start a subscription first."}  (correct — this is the trigger for the fallback)
- Network: POST /api/billing/start-trial → 500 Internal Server Error  (unexpected)
- UI: red toast 'Could not start trial', user remains on /settings/billing. No redirect to Stripe.

Root cause: Settings.jsx openPortal (line 450) catches the 400 and calls startCheckout(currentPlan). startCheckout (line 307) always tries /billing/start-trial FIRST, and only recognises a payload with detail.error='trial_used' as its trigger to move on to the paid /payments/checkout branch. For cancelled.vo the trial endpoint returns HTTP 500 with a plain 'Internal Server Error' body (no JSON detail), so the trialUsed variable is false, the code takes the `!trialUsed` branch (line 323) and shows toast.error + returns without ever POSTing /payments/checkout.

Mitigation (main-agent):
A. Change Settings.jsx:466 from `await startCheckout(currentPlan)` to `await startReactivateCheckout(currentPlan)` (import from `@/lib/reactivate`). This directly POSTs /payments/checkout {trial_days:0} — the same helper ToolLockGate and ReadOnlyLock already use. One-line fix, matches the app-wide reactivation contract.
B. Optionally also fix the backend so /api/billing/start-trial returns 400 {detail:{error:'trial_used'}} for users whose trial was already consumed, instead of 500.

Why this is a real (not cosmetic) bug: spec 3.(a) says 'when backend returns 400 No Stripe customer on record, the UI must NOT dead-end; it should fall back to starting checkout (redirect to checkout.stripe.com).' Empirically the UI dead-ends — spec not met on web.

Backend check: shared endpoints are otherwise correct — /api/payments/checkout returns real cs_test_ URLs, portal 400 message is exactly what the client pattern-matches on, /api/auth/me reports access_state=view_only for cancelled.vo. Only the /billing/start-trial 500 + Settings fallback branching combine to break the flow.
